statement_summary: Program documented; CSF 2.0 and CISA CPGs as the benchmark for reasonable measures
Written designations: vCISO, CPNI compliance officer, CALEA senior officer, 911 certifying official; CALEA refiling within 30 and 90 days
Annual enterprise risk assessment using SP 800-30
Risk acceptance authority by level; no 911-linked risk accepted above Low
Quarterly vCISO report to the audit committee
Evidence-based annual CPNI certification by March 1; counsel review by December 15
Annual policy and standard review
Sanctions, including CPNI misuse and vendor agent discipline
Vendor contract terms and security review before access to CPNI, PII, or the network
Annual reassessment of Tier 1 vendors
Covered List check before buying network equipment; annual CTO attestation
Annual independent control assessment
Retention of CPNI, breach, 911 reliability, and security records
AI tools approved through the AI governance process before use
Unique accounts; no shared accounts on network elements or SYS-18
Role-based least privilege; TACACS+ command authorization
MFA for all access including network elements; security keys for administrators by 2027-03-31
Termination: same-day IdP disable; 24-hour local accounts; rotate shared credentials within 5 business days
Transfers: prior access removed within 5 business days
Quarterly access reviews, including TACACS+ roles and BSS export rights
Privileged access through PAM or TACACS+; network elements only from jump hosts
Lockout and idle timeouts
Break-glass credentials sealed at CO-1 and CO-4; tested quarterly
Password rules; vaulted secrets; default credentials and SNMP strings changed before connection
Customer authentication by telephone (password) and in store (photo ID); no call detail screens for overflow agents
Customer authentication online and in the chatbot without biographical or account information
Immediate account-change notices to the number or address of record, including SYS-18
Business customer exemption only with a dedicated representative and CPNI contract
Vendor remote access through the access broker; no shared vendor accounts
Lawful-intercept access limited to named employees with lawful authorization
Incident response plan and runbooks for CPNI intrusion and ransomware
Immediate reporting of suspected incidents to the NOC or security team
Incident register with discovery and determination times; serves as the CPNI breach record
Severity 1 definition and crisis management team
Service first: NOC assesses 911 impact before containment; PSAP and NORS clocks
CPNI breach determination with counsel; date and basis recorded
Notification deadlines per the P08 matrix (CPNI, CALEA, outage, opt-out failure, state law)
No ransom without CEO, counsel, insurer, and OFAC check
Day-0 evidence preservation; SYS-10 forensics only under CALEA-authorized staff
Annual tabletop with NOC, regulatory affairs, customer operations, counsel, MDR
Lessons learned within 30 days into the risk register, POA&M, and training
Four classification levels; CPNI and intercept data Restricted; NORS and 911 records Confidential
Whole customer account record protected to the CPNI standard
CPNI use only as 64.2005 allows; approval checked at time of use; no tracking of calls to competitors
Models and AI tools read CPNI only through approval-filtered views
Campaign approval and register; disclosure record; biennial notice to all voice accounts; full translation
Encryption at rest and in transit for Restricted data
Restricted data only in approved systems; never in unapproved AI tools
Backups encrypted, isolated, immutable, and restore-tested quarterly
Retention: CDRs 18 months online; SSN digits removed; intercept and 911 records retained
Certified media and network element disposal
Signed acknowledgment at hire and annually, including vendor agents
Annual awareness training; quarterly phishing exercises
CPNI training before access and annually, including vendor agents
Role-based training for network engineers and NOC staff
Need-to-know account lookups; monthly review of call detail views
Approved AI tools only; no CPNI or configurations in unapproved tools
Recording and transcription only with the approved notice; all-party consent
